== Notes ==
* If you recast this skill while it is still active, you will not receive the health gain effect, nor will it trigger other skills' effects upon end.
* Combines well with [[Signet of Pious Light]] or [[Pious Restoration]] for a large self [[spike]] health gain. Also with [[Twin Moon Sweep]] for quick enchantment removal and greater health gain.
* An excellent [[cover]] enchantment particularly against skills such as [[Shatter Enchantment]] as the health gain often cancels out the damage.
* Can be used to "trick" [[NPC]] [[AI]] into avoiding your character, since characters with the lowest maximum health will [[aggro]] NPCs first.

{{bug|Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes [[health gain]] and not [[healing]].}}
